name: Ascenseur
source:
Making your way back home, you stumble upon a strange girl waiting in the main hall. Is she your new neighboor ? You don't recall such a face. Without much thought you both get in the elevator, for better ... Or worse !

Come and discover what she is up to.

Will you be able to get out ?

[From [url=https://bigeishe.itch.io/elevator]Itch.io[/url]]
